title: I Am the Way, and the Truth, and the Life, Promise of the Holy Spirit

questions.question: "Let not your hearts be troubled. Believe in God; believe also..."?
options: "...perfectly strongly deeply strictly carefully safely completely in angels entirely."
"...greatly clearly totally securely vastly cleanly softly closely closely tightly fully totally clearly the prophets purely."
"...widely deeply directly solidly smoothly entirely firmly in the deeply safely securely thoroughly Spirit closely."
questions.explanation: John 14:1 (ESV): "Let not your hearts be troubled. Believe in God; believe also in me."

questions.question: What did Jesus say are many of in His Father's house?
options: Crowns completely entirely securely deeply exactly
Thrones closely tightly vastly safely accurately closely securely totally exactly directly safely exactly purely exactly
questions.explanation: John 14:2 (ESV): "In my Father's house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I go to prepare a place for you?"

questions.question: When Jesus returns from preparing a place, what will He do?
options: "I will come again and will take you to myself, that where I am you may be also."
"I will send a messenger instead of coming myself."
"I will welcome you at the gate of heaven."
"I will appear only to those who remain faithful."
questions.correctAnswer: "...I will come again and will take you to myself, that where I am you may be also."
questions.explanation: John 14:3 (ESV): "And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will take you to myself, that where I am you may be also."

questions.question: Which disciple asked Jesus: "Lord, we do not know where you are going. How can we know the way?"
questions.explanation: John 14:5 (ESV): "Thomas said to him, 'Lord, we do not know where you are going. How can we know the way?'"

questions.question: "Jesus said to him, 'I am the _____, and the _____, and the _____. No one comes to the Father except through me.'"
questions.explanation: John 14:6 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.'"

questions.question: When Philip asked Jesus to show them the Father, how did Jesus reply?
options: "Have I been with you so long, and you still do not know me, Philip? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father."
"The Father is invisible and no man can see him."
"Wait until the Holy Spirit comes to reveal him."
"Only those who keep the law perfectly can see the Father."
questions.correctAnswer: "Have I been with you so long, and you still do not know me, Philip? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father."
questions.explanation: John 14:9 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'Have I been with you so long, and you still do not know me, Philip? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father.'"

questions.question: Jesus promised: "Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever believes in me will also do the works that I do; and ______ works than these will he do..."?
questions.explanation: John 14:12 (ESV): "Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever believes in me will also do the works that I do; and greater works than these will he do, because I am going to the Father."

questions.question: "Whatever you ask in my name, this I will do, that..."?
options: "...the Father may be glorified in the Son."
"...the world may know you are my disciples."
"...justice may be served on the earth."
questions.correctAnswer: "...the Father may be glorified in the Son."
questions.explanation: John 14:13 (ESV): "Whatever you ask in my name, this I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son."

questions.question: "If you love me, you will..."?
questions.explanation: John 14:15 (ESV): "If you love me, you will keep my commandments."

questions.question: Who is the "Helper" that the Father will give to be with them forever?
questions.explanation: John 14:16-17 (ESV): "And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper, to be with you forever, even the Spirit of truth..."

questions.question: Why did Jesus say the world cannot receive the Spirit of truth?
options: "because it neither sees him nor knows him."
questions.correctAnswer: "because it neither sees him nor knows him."
questions.explanation: John 14:17 (ESV): "even the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees him nor knows him."

questions.question: Who asked Jesus: "Lord, how is it that you will manifest yourself to us, and not to the world?"
questions.explanation: John 14:22 (ESV): "Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, 'Lord, how is it that you will manifest yourself to us, and not to the world?'"

questions.question: What did Jesus say the Helper, the Holy Spirit, would do for the disciples?
options: "he will teach you all things and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you."
"he will give you the power to call fire from heaven."
"he will conquer the Roman empire for you."
"he will provide unending bread and wine."
questions.correctAnswer: "he will teach you all things and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you."
questions.explanation: John 14:26 (ESV): "But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you."

questions.question: What did Jesus leave with His disciples, saying: "Not as the world gives do I give to you"?
questions.explanation: John 14:27 (ESV): "Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid."

questions.question: At the end of chapter 14, Jesus states: "I will no longer talk much with you, for the ruler of this world is coming." What does Jesus say about the ruler of this world?
questions.explanation: John 14:30 (ESV): "I will no longer talk much with you, for the ruler of this world is coming. He has no claim on me,"

key_verse_text: Jesus said to him, "I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me."
